tracks.title: Mummy Was An Asteroid, Daddy Was A Small Non-Stick Kitchen Utensil

verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1975 (UK).

physical: Pressed by Island Records Manufacturing Ltd
cutters: Porky Prime Cut: George Peckham cut the lacquer

sides.value: I-7 HELP 19 A-2U A PORKY PRIME CUT

notes.text:
Recorded at Island Studios, London, January 1975
Printed in England by Robor Limited.

This later release (apparently side one was re-cut to correct an edit error on the first cut) was issued in early 1977, and can be identified by the etched 'PORKY PRIME CUT' in the side A runout, and rectangular inner sleeve, compared to the original
